body: That answers it — per-spouse columns confirmed (`pbusinc`/`sbusinc` for business income, `pprofinc`/`sprofinc` for professions), which is exactly how #1051 wired the emulator (`pbusinc` → primary, `sbusinc` → spouse). No change needed. Understood on the limited testing pending the tax-expert recruit — closing this as answered; the expert-dependent items stay tracked in #1053/#384.
